criteria.criterion: The selected native selector→Construction→Testing→assessment carriage uses compact context/task/producer/member references, with first bodies retained once at existing actual Result admission. Same body reuse does not change source/observation/actor/Run attribution. No expanded-body transport/route/input copies, new store/event/controller/service, generic CAS or legacy fallback. Retire the superseded copy/re-hash/revalidation paths; do not wrap and preserve them behind a new resolver.

Actual-owner deterministic tests prove first-body admission, two or more unchanged handoffs, changed-member invalidation, full selected bytes and typed missing/tampered/foreign/denied/stale/pending references. They count semantic body occurrences/bytes and owner acquisitions, not just compressed file size. Nonempty allowed/denied GC03/correspondence/B10/B11 cases remain meaningful and green; body lookup still obeys current occurrence and grants.

A model-free actual-owner 965-member equivalence case (same paths/state/file identities/lengths/content digests and complete bytes, three changed members) covers two or more handoffs without body multiplication. Cold reconstruction and exact-intent replacement-Run continuation use retained history/evidence without original mutable source, do not rerun committed producer work or invent assessment, and match terminal/result/current-input/lineage. New work/effects still reobserve current W. Existing saga/failure/rollback/poison/envelope/refusal gates stay exact. No retrocredit for003.

The nine existing C2 purposes/IDs/toolchain/STDO environment are retained; source-correspondence and focused-owner arguments cover the selected finite P1 source/test set. All nine commands pass on the actual current source/build/package/artifact, with meaningful required cases and no bypass or new skip/todo. On one fixed model-free965-member fixture, C2 compares the source-grounded old expanded representation with the actual new-owner compact representation: record serialized bytes, semantic body-occurrence counts, exact reconstructed logical bytes/metadata and owner acquisition counts. Record actual new-owner cold/warm local wall/CPU/RSS measurements with method/cache limitations. Label the old expanded projection as a structural/serialization baseline, not an executed old runtime; do not claim matched old-runtime CPU/RSS/wall or a full end-to-end speedup. Root's later actual matched old/new installed-runtime resource comparison and one live composition are separate post-candidate proof, not native UAT conditions or facts supplied in advance.

limits: Read source/Product grant and exact HOW; all actual admissions and effects remain native-owned.
